Appliance Load Audit

Enter typical daily use and select when each appliance operates. Daytime loads guide PV/self-consumption sizing; nighttime loads guide battery sizing.

Tip: use the appliance nameplate watts where possible. For inverter air conditioners, pumps and refrigerators, actual average consumption can be lower than rated watts because the compressor cycles or modulates. Adjust the estimated watts or operating hours to reflect real use.

Current PV generation offset—
Enter monthly consumption from the bill and review appliance usage to evaluate fit.
System sizing suggestions will appear here based on the bill, appliance audit and current design assumptions.

Planning estimate only. Solar offset means estimated daily PV harvest divided by estimated daily energy demand; it is not a guaranteed bill reduction. Actual savings depend on self-consumption, export rules, shading, weather, tariffs and system losses. Battery sizing also depends on night-time loads and desired backup hours.

Solar Panel Specifications

Enter panel data from the exact manufacturer datasheet. Cold-corrected Voc is an estimate using the entered temperature coefficient and minimum site temperature.

Inverter Specifications

As inverter limits are entered, the validation checks and array calculations update automatically. These checks are screening estimates; verify each MPPT/string arrangement against the exact inverter manual.

Battery Specifications & Autonomy

Use the battery manufacturer's datasheet for the recommended charging current. The design estimate will not exceed the lowest applicable limit: configured inverter charge current, manufacturer recommendation (when entered), battery maximum charge current, and BMS limit. Do not guess this value when the datasheet is unavailable.

Price Book

The Price Book is the master catalogue for equipment and material prices. Add panels, inverters, and batteries as equipment, then select them in System Design to automatically include the selected models and prices in the BOM. All items marked Consumable are automatically added as standard BOM materials. Quantities can be fixed, per panel, or per system.

Equipment Specs Book

Store optional manufacturer specifications against each Price Book product. When a product with saved specs is selected in System Design, available values sync automatically. If specs are incomplete, selection still proceeds and the app shows a note; missing values can be entered manually in System Design.

Select an equipment item to manage its specifications.

Quick Price Update

Choose any Price Book item, enter its new price, and update it. The matching row below, linked BOM line, costing, and proposal total will refresh automatically. The price is saved with this project draft.

Mounting hardware is modeled as a configurable “mounting set per panel” by default. Adjust the unit definition and quantity factor to match your actual kit (rails, L-feet, clamps, splices, and roof type). The app does not infer roof-specific structural requirements.
